key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Basal rosette or low crown sending up long flowering stalks.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Mostly basal to lower cauline, deeply pinnatifid to pinnate-lobed; rough or hairy.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Yellow rays surrounding yellow disks; heads solitary or few on long peduncles.

key_traits.label: Phyllaries
key_traits.text: In several series, green, often appressed.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: basal-lobed leaves; long naked peduncles; classic yellow daisy heads; perennial clump
